preconditions.description: The room dimensions n and m are within the specified range.
At least one of the room dimensions is even.

preconditions.expression: len(current_config) == n and all(len(row) == m for row in current_config)
preconditions.description: The current configuration has n rows and each row has m characters.

preconditions.expression: len(desired_config) == n and all(len(row) == m for row in desired_config)
preconditions.description: The desired configuration has n rows and each row has m characters.

preconditions.expression: all(char in {'L', 'R', 'U', 'D'} for row in current_config for char in row)
preconditions.description: Each character in the current configuration is one of 'L', 'R', 'U', 'D'.

preconditions.expression: all(char in {'L', 'R', 'U', 'D'} for row in desired_config for char in row)
preconditions.description: Each character in the desired configuration is one of 'L', 'R', 'U', 'D'.

postconditions.description: The number of operations is either -1 (impossible) or a non-negative integer not exceeding 100000.

postconditions.expression: return_value[0] == -1 or (len(return_value) - 1 == return_value[0] and all(isinstance(op, tuple) and len(op) == 2 and 1 <= op[0] <= n and 1 <= op[1] <= m for op in return_value[1:]))
postconditions.description: If the number of operations is not -1, the subsequent lines contain valid (row, column) coordinates for the operations.
If the number of operations is not -1, applying the operations to the current configuration results in the desired configuration.
